ModMetaData.name: Honor.Core
ModMetaData.author: Honor Mod Series
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7 have separate builds. The 1.6.4871 reference build is code-validated only; direct gameplay testing is deferred. 한국어: 1.6/1.7 버전별 빌드이며 1.6.4871 참조 빌드는 코드 검사만 통과했고 실제 플레이 검증은 보류 중입니다. Honor.CoreThe base module: five honor Need tiers, event changes, slow decay with tier floors, mandatory insult duels, challenger ideology rules, matched swords/knives/revolvers, armor removal, arena safety, immediate field tending, honor traits, settings and save/load. No DLC required. Requires Harmony (1.6: 2.x / 1.7: 3.x) for 1.7. 한국어: 기본 명예 욕구·5단계 하한·강제 결투·동일 장비·방어구 탈의·결투장·응급처치·특성·설정·저장. Harmony (1.6: 2.x / 1.7: 3.x) 필수, DLC 필수 아님.
